Music Discovery Needs Taste, Not Infinite Skips

MusicAppsMar 22, 20264 min read

The best music apps feel edited. Discovery improves when algorithms behave more like a trusted record shop and less like a slot machine.

Discovery works best when it feels like a point of view, not an endless pile of options.

What Matters

Context, mood, catalog depth, and human-readable recommendations help listeners build better habits.
